text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      DETECT_SPAM: true
      DETECT_AI_GENERATED: true
      DETECT_LINK_SPAM: true
      DETECT_GENERAL_SPAM: true
      SPAM_LABEL: spam
      AI_GENERATED_LABEL: ai-generated
      MINIMIZE_COMMENTS: true
    steps:
      - uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
```
